name: Living Worlds fixes
description: Small client-side fixes taken from L2-Living-Worlds. Now: refresh the client after a cursed weapon leaves its owner on death.

CursedWeaponRefresh.description: Resend the inventory and character info after a cursed weapon was dropped or vanished on its owner's death.

CursedWeaponRefreshDelay.description: Delay after death, so the stock drop has finished.
